Access.name: loadDispoBasket
Access.Query: select disp.cod_carl , disp.cod_bozza_disp_carl , disp.cod_pdf_instance , (select val_attrib from sogg_posizdisp.dett_appog_bozza_disp_carl_semplt idRacc where idRacc.cod_chiav_attrib='COD_RCMND' and idRacc.cod_bozza_disp_carl=disp.cod_bozza_disp_carl) , carl.cod_modal_ricz_docum from sogg_posizdisp.dett_bozza_disp_carl_semplt disp inner join sogg_posizdisp.anag_carl_semplt carl on carl.cod_carl=disp.cod_carl where disp.cod_carl = ? and disp.gstd_f_esist = 'S' and carl.gstd_f_esist = 'S' order by disp.prg_ordmto_disp

Access.name: loadModuliDispoBasket
Access.Query: select prg_docum_disp_carl, cod_mod_pdf_publisher from sogg_posizdisp.dett_docum_bozza_disp_carl_semplt where cod_bozza_disp_carl = ? and gstd_f_esist = 'S' order by prg_ordmto_docum

Access.name: loadCampiModuloDispoBasket
Access.Query: select den_campo_docum , val_campo_docum from sogg_posizdisp.dett_campo_docum_bozza_disp_carl_semplt where cod_bozza_disp_carl = ? and prg_docum_disp_carl = ? and gstd_f_esist = 'S'
